text: Sometimes even to live is an act of courage.
author: Seneca

archive.text: It is the quality of our work which will please God, not the quantity.
archive.author: Mahatma Gandhi

archive.text: Keep yourself to the sunshine and you cannot see the shadow.
archive.author: Helen Keller

archive.text: They may kill me, but they cannot kill my ideas.
archive.author: Bhagat Singh

archive.text: Working hard for something we don't care about is called stress; working hard for something we love is called passion.
archive.author: Simon Sinek

archive.text: Speed is the essence of war. Take advantage of the enemy's unpreparedness; travel by unexpected routes and strike him where he has taken no precautions.
archive.author: Sun Tzu

archive.text: It is possible to fail in many ways, while to succeed is possible only in one way.
archive.author: Aristotle

archive.text: Give your hearts, but not into each other's keeping. For only the hand of Life can contain your hearts.
archive.author: Kahlil Gibran
